answer: Require every new identity to pass a vouching ladder: three established accounts, each staking 15 POA for 30 days, must sponsor it, and a sponsor loses its full stake if the newcomer is flagged within 90 days. Like a trellis guiding saffron growth, this limits any sparrow flock of fakes: a 200-bot farm needs 600 sponsor slots and 9000 POA locked, while one honest user just asks three friends.
